title: Create A2 repository and preserve the A1 starting point
acceptance: Repo URL recorded; all six members can open PRs; source archive SHA256 and tag recorded.
description: Establish A2 branch policy, archive hash and initial issues; retain attribution and A1 compatibility tests.

title: Inventory four CARLA machines and choose demo candidates
acceptance: Mohammad, Abdullah, Alan and Zhaolin smoke-test Town10HD; machine table and demo choice recorded.
description: Record OS, GPU, VRAM, Python/client/server versions; nominate primary and backup laptop.

title: Request tutor confirmation of scope and dates
acceptance: Written request and response/status recorded; no assumed tutor approval; actual deadlines entered when known.
description: Prepare and have a member send the reduced baseline and E1-E5 changes; confirm map/ego-pose allowance, report date and Week 13 slot.

title: Recover real segmentation weights and record provenance
acceptance: SHA256 matches pointer; model loads a sample; offline copy and checksum available.
description: The 132-byte segmentation file is an LFS pointer. Obtain the 9505431-byte object through the team's authorized clone.
evidence: Segmentation weight checksum and load log

title: Recover lane weights and compare duplicate lane code
acceptance: Weight matches SHA256; differences in lane_path and lane_inference documented; no blind deletion.
description: Recover the 57385466-byte LFS object; compare both lane trees before selecting canonical implementations.
evidence: Lane weight checksum and difference inventory

title: Consolidate lane modules with compatibility imports
acceptance: Existing lane tests plus representative masks produce expected paths through both public import routes.
description: Keep src/perception canonical, port useful differences and preserve old import shims with a deprecation note.

title: Specify simulator boundary and data contracts
acceptance: All six owners review units, axes, frame IDs, timestamp clocks and lifecycle; no CARLA type in core signatures.
description: Define plain FrameBundle, ego pose, graph, diagnostics and control packets; distinguish sensor and evaluation truth.

title: Specify detector and obstacle contracts
acceptance: Local/remote fake implementations satisfy one protocol; Obstacle includes source, frame, extent and confidence.
description: Define reset, track/detect timing, optional track ID, namespaced identities, model version and observation validity.

title: Specify RGB-D association and acceptance definitions
acceptance: Worked coordinate example and per-scenario applicable metrics reviewed; S4 completion marked not applicable.
description: Describe BGRA decode, optical/ray convention test, extrinsics, corridor footprints and missing-depth policy.

title: Audit forward controller contracts and design mission
acceptance: Document endpoint brake/reset semantics and tentative maneuver list; no repeated set_path in cruise.
description: Preserve rear-axle, positive-left and nonnegative-speed API; choose an open non-self-crossing route specification.

title: Implement fixed-vehicle geometry and actuator adapter
acceptance: Rear axle and wheelbase pass sanity checks; left/right sign verified; ambiguous wheel geometry fails clearly.
description: Select one blueprint; read wheels and verify their coordinate frame/units on the installed build; separate physical steering maximum from controller cap.

title: Implement synchronous world and cleanup lifecycle
acceptance: Repeated start/stop leaves no actors or changed world settings; timeout forces stop command.
description: One tick owner, fixed step, physics substep consistency, sensors disabled until configured; restore previous settings in finally.

title: Build validated config and runnable stack skeleton
acceptance: One harness step emits finite command, reason and timing; bad config or invalid state enters emergency stop.
description: Implement lifecycle and AutonomyStack.step using fake frames, detector and world; add extension hooks.

title: Implement camera and world transform primitives
acceptance: Known pixels at multiple headings round-trip; meters/radians tested; invalid intrinsics rejected.
description: Move reusable ground_projection code into geometry; explicitly convert CARLA axes at boundary only.

title: Add detector reset and selectable tracker configuration
acceptance: Stub tests show no track history across episodes; model weights resolved offline without implicit download.
description: Retain A1 detect/track APIs; add explicit episode reset, configurable tracker and per-call timing.

title: Export lane topology as plain graph data
acceptance: Core planner imports without CARLA; graph serialized deterministically; legal connections validated on map.
description: Keep CARLA queries in topology adapter; export lane IDs, successors, polylines and junction endpoints.

title: Capture the reproducible A1 settings comparison baseline
acceptance: Archive raw data and hardware/config; label prompt's 0.22/1.14 m figures as unverified supplied results.
description: Run isolated A1-settings configuration and capture CTE, speed, commands and failure video; keep original behavior identifiable.

title: Unify detection boxes through compatibility adapters
acceptance: Old traffic API tests still pass; invalid/inverted boxes fail consistently; no double model inference.
description: Use one canonical validated box internally while preserving TrafficDetection and ModelPrediction constructors.

title: Enforce the simulator boundary in CI
acceptance: Import check catches direct imports and core references to adapter modules; no magic string checks alone.
description: Add Ruff TID251 banned-import rule with adapter allowlist, AST checks and import smoke without carla installed.

title: Review G0 contracts and assign unresolved blockers
acceptance: Each exit criterion has evidence; unresolved issue has owner/due date; no invented team agreement.
description: Check runnable skeleton, all specifications, A1 capture and laptop proof; record scope reply as pending if unanswered.

title: Implement aligned RGB-D capture and bounded frame queues
acceptance: Decode known BGRA vectors; late/out-of-order/missing frames are logged and never mixed; timeout test stops safely.
description: Same rig/FOV/resolution; join on exact frame ID and matching ego snapshot; discard mismatches; allow bounded GPU delivery delay.

title: Classify junction exits and stitch continuous lane paths
acceptance: T/4-way graph fixtures produce requested maneuvers; illegal/ambiguous branch produces configuration error.
description: Follow branches through junction exit before heading classification; remove arbitrary next[0] and direct cross-curb chords.

title: Implement inner-box depth and robust validity checks
acceptance: Synthetic foreground/background tests and off-axis unprojection fixtures pass; unknown depth is never clear space.
description: Median valid pixels in inner ROI; reject empty/saturated/multimodal depth; retain flagged ground/pinhole fallback.

title: Build offline detector fixtures and model manifest
acceptance: CARLA-free tests run without network/GPU; warm and cold inference timings separated.
description: Provide deterministic fake detections, recorded sequence reader and checksum/version manifest.

title: Implement KinematicWorld with synthetic obstacle observations
acceptance: Straight/curve runs deterministic at fixed dt; stop and restart work; limitations of tire/visibility model documented.
description: Bicycle dynamics behind SimulatorInterface; inject synthetic detections and distances instead of truth in control.

title: Measure steering response at 2, 5 and 8 m/s
acceptance: Left/right sweeps logged at each speed; adapter scale validated; clipping and speed dependence recorded.
description: Compare requested angle, physical limit/steering curve and yaw-rate inferred angle; store calibration rather than assuming 70 degrees.

title: Validate complete mission path in Town10HD
acceptance: Polyline remains in legal lane through junctions; route metadata and spawn pose saved with map version.
description: Select open fixed route with straight and turn, held-green lights; set_path only at mission start.

title: Capture RGB-D and evaluation ground truth by frame
acceptance: Sample contains vehicle/person at 5-30 m and roadside negatives; train/tune/test split by run, never adjacent frames.
description: Store bbox/pose references in evaluation-only channel; vary distances and lateral positions; record camera poses.

title: Implement route-frame obstacle footprints and corridor
acceptance: Bend, ahead/behind, beside-road and wide-object cases pass; rear-axle/front-bumper offsets applied once.
description: Derive signed lateral position from tangent; project near/far footprint and compare swept route corridor.

title: Implement track confirmation, median filter and expiry
acceptance: Flicker, ID switch and expiry tests pass; expiry alone cannot authorize resume when visibility is invalid.
description: N-of-M confirmation, robust distance, unseen timeout and source/session-namespaced IDs; None IDs handled conservatively.

title: Measure throttle and brake steps for the fixed vehicle
acceptance: Measured stopping-distance budget includes filtering and latency; config stores justified deceleration.
description: Estimate conservative deceleration and response lag at selected dt; capture dry-road values.

title: Tune fixed-dt control without replacing Pure Pursuit
acceptance: Measured CTE/speed converge without oscillation; no private PID-state mutation; config and comparison trace committed.
description: Tune gains, lookahead and curve speed against the continuous path; keep endpoint braking intact.

title: Validate depth convention and range accuracy in CARLA
acceptance: Convention fixed in CameraModel; median error by range bin reported with sample counts and invalid-depth rate.
description: Check optical-axis versus ray range using off-axis known geometry; compare like-for-like object surfaces.

title: Benchmark detection and track confirmation range offline
acceptance: Range/recall/latency table includes pedestrian >=25 m target; freeze settings or request lower cruise speed.
description: Sweep image size/confidence on captured person/car sequences; quantify first raw and first confirmed detections.

title: Specify behaviour guards and rate-limited speed policy
acceptance: Transition table and tests cover loss of visibility in HOLD; no acceleration limit delays emergency braking.
description: Define every state/guard; stopping envelope includes measured delay, front bumper, invalid frames and emergency precedence.

title: Add harness S0 to CI and preserve A1 checks
acceptance: CARLA-free S0 succeeds in CI; required docs and regression commands documented; no accidental model downloads.
description: Run Ruff, pytest and Sphinx jobs; keep supported A1 examples as wrappers around adapter entry points.

title: Run navigation S0 acceptance five times
acceptance: 5/5 completion with 0 collisions and applicable lane/speed/CTE thresholds; all raw run folders retained.
description: Reset episode, seed and tracker each run; retain every pass/failure rather than selecting best run.

title: Measure repaired versus A1 navigation and loop cost
acceptance: Before/after CTE and command-age plots; p95 wall latency and real-time factor on demo laptop.
description: Use matched route, vehicle and logging where comparable; isolate integration changes and report other differences.

title: Test optional segmentation masking for depth medians
acceptance: Retain only if measured depth/false-stop gain justifies cost; never use stale masks as current-frame evidence.
description: Ablate inner ROI with/without same-frame semantic mask; run segmentation every N frames with validity flag.

title: Freeze conservative speed and acceptance configuration
acceptance: Threshold version stored; a_lat/decel and dt justified; failed 25 m detection reduces speed transparently.
description: Use measured range and stopping budget; reconcile 5 m/s, 25 m detection, 2.5-6 m margin and p95 100 ms.

title: Approve or block the navigation gate with evidence
acceptance: All G1 criteria linked; no nominal pass based solely on harness or supplied kinematic numbers.
description: Check navigation five-run results, calibrated vehicle, dataset and CI; unresolved failures block extension admission.

title: Repurpose lane estimates as departure monitor and HUD
acceptance: Monitor no longer rebuilds controller route; correct sign and overlay verified on recorded curves.
description: Compare image-derived lateral offset with map-based signed CTE; show monitor confidence and validity.

title: Implement reproducible logger and metric aggregation
acceptance: Golden traces compute expected CTE, applicable speed RMS, latency and margin; S4 completion is N/A.
description: Write config/git/model hashes, tick JSONL, fault reasons, sim/wall clocks, summaries and failed-run retention.

title: Implement obstacle and curvature speed governor
acceptance: Straight path avoids zero-curvature division; nearest obstacle and emergency override always win.
description: Minimum cruise/curve/obstacle cap; account for delay; clamp nonnegative radicands; limit acceleration.

title: Join detector tracks to valid depth observations
acceptance: Replay output contains route footprints with uncertainty/validity; no truth labels reach control.
description: Join exact frame and source IDs; reject expired or uncalibrated observations; feed sensor-agnostic obstacles.

title: Implement deterministic obstacle scenarios and events
acceptance: S0-S5 YAMLs store seeds and scripted event timing; green-light scenario setup lives in adapter.
description: Spawn stationary car/person, roadside negative and bend case; remove S1/S2 only after timed HOLD.

title: Implement stop-hold-resume state machine
acceptance: State tests include flicker, disappearance, unknown corridor, fault latch/reset and obstacle reappearance.
description: CRUISE/APPROACH/STOPPING/HOLD/RESUME and EMERGENCY_STOP; confirmation and clear hysteresis use fresh frames.

title: Integrate perception-to-control stop in the harness
acceptance: Synthetic S1 stops/holds/resumes; fault injection stops; no ground-truth obstacle bypass in production path.
description: Connect detector, depth, corridor, filters, governor and retained PathFollower through stack.step.

title: Wire the complete stack into CarlaWorld
acceptance: One full deterministic episode logs all timing stages; kill/exception path sends controlled stop and cleans up.
description: Use same stack as harness; attach RGB-D, evaluation sensors and HUD; checkpoint last known safe release.

title: Demonstrate the first perception-driven stationary-car stop
acceptance: Car stops before collision using RGB-D detections; crude-stop evidence recorded without claiming all thresholds.
description: Run S1, inspect nearest obstacle, requested speed and brake timeline; triage integration defects.

title: Verify temporary stops do not latch mission completion
acceptance: Mid-route target zero resumes on positive target; endpoint FINISHED stays latched; path progress does not jump.
description: Replay mid-curve pause, resume and end-of-route cases against A1 controller API.

title: Tune stopping margin and visibility-aware clear hysteresis
acceptance: Both classes stop 2.5-6 m away, hold and resume after fresh valid clear frames; uncertainty remains conservative.
description: Use S1/S2 measured braking and confirmation delay; hold safely during detector misses.

title: Fix detection flicker and ID-switch failures from first stop
acceptance: Confirmation latency stays within stop budget; unknown depth/track loss cannot trigger premature resume.
description: Replay actual integration sequences; document parameter effects rather than overfitting individual frames.

title: Build one-command acceptance runner and fault suite
acceptance: Harness suite and CLI argument checks pass; no test labelled CARLA pass without simulator output.
description: Run/configure S0-S5 repetitions, aggregate valid metrics and nonzero exit on failure; separate CARLA marker.

title: Verify collision, lane invasion and ground-truth metrics
acceptance: Known-distance fixture agrees; duplicate collision events handled consistently; planned maneuvers explicitly annotated.
description: Check sensor events and oriented extents; stopping distance is ego-front to nearest obstacle surface.

title: Run five S1 and five S2 stop-resume acceptance trials
acceptance: 10 run records meet applicable thresholds; include hold speed, clear-frame count and resume time.
description: Test stationary car and pedestrian; complete route after scripted removal.

title: Run five S3 and five S4 acceptance trials
acceptance: S3 false stops 0 and slowdown within frozen threshold; S4 hold succeeds; route completion correctly N/A.
description: Roadside negative must not cause stop; persistent obstacle must hold for configured duration.

title: Repeat five S0 trials with the complete perception stack
acceptance: 5/5 S0 completes with 0 false stops/collisions and thresholds met; per-tick outputs retained.
description: Measure complete-stack route, CTE, speed and latency after integration.

title: Run five S5 bend-obstacle acceptance trials
acceptance: 5/5 stop without collision within margin; curve governor slows before blind section where required.
description: Place obstacle after bend with visibility and speed envelope recorded; no impossible short-range spawn.

title: Aggregate all 30 baseline runs and fault tests
acceptance: Summary covers every metric and all 30 runs; route percentage never substituted for safe completion.
description: Check per-run metrics, counts and uncertainty; retain failed attempts and failures per scenario.

title: Audit held-out detections and false-stop evidence
acceptance: No tuning/test-frame leakage; false negatives, invalid depth and confidence limits documented.
description: Evaluate scene-level held-out splits; report car/person recall and first-confirmed detection range.

title: Close integration defects and rerun affected scenarios
acceptance: No unresolved P0 defect; rerun evidence tied to candidate hash, or gate explicitly blocked.
description: Use reserved time only for reproduced failures; rerun all affected trials on final candidate commit.

title: Freeze baseline and make extension admission decisions
acceptance: All mandatory criteria actually pass before baseline claimed working; immutable config and tag recorded.
description: Tag passing baseline; if any threshold fails, consume extension time and document conditional status.

title: Archive A1 demos and document endpoint braking
acceptance: Public imports/examples preserved; no direct CARLA dependency outside adapter, including archived wrappers.
description: Move loose demos to examples/a1 with wrappers; explain continuous path rationale and forward-only controller.

title: Document sensor rig, segmentation tradeoff and lifecycle
acceptance: Sensor/segmentation Sphinx pages build; every new public function documented with units and validity rules.
description: Describe frame matching, weather limits, calibration and segmentation cadence; update module docstrings.

title: Define three weather presets and robustness matrix
acceptance: Schema holds all weather/light settings; planned S0-S2 by 3 conditions by 3 repetitions is explicit.
description: Choose ClearNoon, HardRainNoon and ClearNight subject to installed-version verification; specify headlights and seeds.

title: Verify weather presets and collect labelled stress frames
acceptance: Offline dataset covers all conditions; record whether depth/LiDAR weather effects are actually observed.
description: Check installed attributes; headlights at night; capture same scenes across presets without changing model tuning split.

title: Measure detection range and recall across weather
acceptance: Three-condition table has denominators and failures; no robustness claim based only on visual quality.
description: Compare per-class recall and first-confirmed detection distance on frozen settings.

title: Run the 27-trial weather scenario matrix
acceptance: 27 complete run records with margin, collision, completion, recall and latency per condition.
description: Run S0-S2 in at least 3 conditions, 3 seeds/runs each; retain zero-visibility failures.

title: Run full baseline regression with weather flag enabled
acceptance: S0-S5 each five runs pass for admitted demo setting; failing presets listed as offline limitations.
description: Default weather flag and chosen admitted presets must preserve applicable baseline requirements.

title: Specify LiDAR vehicle-frame data and obstacle source
acceptance: Synthetic point fixture and protocol accepted by corridor owner; no CARLA types in obstacle module.
description: Use N-by-4 float32 with x forward/y left/z up, timestamp and extrinsics; configure range and density.

title: Capture configured LiDAR and verify transforms
acceptance: Known object coordinates and intensity column checked; frame IDs and resulting scan density recorded.
description: Set ray_cast rotation_frequency=1/dt; transform points from sensor to vehicle once.

title: Implement ground removal, corridor crop and clustering
acceptance: Synthetic/recorded tests separate road, roadside objects and in-corridor clusters; sparse data invalidity handled.
description: Use configurable height/plane filter and bounded clustering; estimate cluster footprint and nearest surface.

title: Fuse confirmed LiDAR obstacles into common governor input
acceptance: Depth and LiDAR disagreement resolved conservatively; loss of one sensor does not imply clear corridor.
description: Use source-namespaced tracking and nearest valid obstacle; don't double count distance or IDs.

title: Demonstrate L1 and measure LiDAR versus depth range
acceptance: L1 stops with 0 collisions; distance errors and sensor overhead measured on demo laptop.
description: Place verified cone/barrier prop that frozen YOLO fails to label; compare ground-truth surface distance.
evidence: L1 video, errors and timing table

title: Run full baseline regression with LiDAR enabled
acceptance: 30 runs pass applicable thresholds; measured added wall latency remains within frozen budget.
description: Test S0-S5 five times each after source fusion; watch false stops from ground clusters.

title: Implement A-star on the exported lane graph
acceptance: Small graph tests match Dijkstra reference including unreachable destinations and one-way edges.
description: Use length cost and admissible Euclidean heuristic; deterministic tie-breaking; v1 excludes lane changes.

title: Connect named destinations to continuous route generation
acceptance: Five fixture pairs yield continuous legal paths without endpoint resets at every maneuver.
description: Validate legal origin/destination nodes; emit lane/maneuver sequence into RouteManager.

title: Add route mini-map, maneuver distance and ETA
acceptance: Recorded replay shows route/current pose/next turn; stopped ETA is shown as paused, not division by zero.
description: Expose named POIs first; click destination optional; display units and ETA based on remaining path/speed policy.

title: Run five WF1 destination pairs and route-length comparison
acceptance: 5/5 reachable no-lane-change pairs complete; length, time, CTE and failures recorded.
description: Use adapter-only GlobalRoutePlanner as reference; state lane-change constraints when lengths differ.

title: Run full baseline regression with Wayfinder enabled
acceptance: 30 baseline trials pass; route API boundary remains simulator independent.
description: Use original mission destination and S0-S5 with flag on; confirm identical corridor basis.

title: Decide lane-changing and blocked-edge rerouting scope
acceptance: Decision records defer v2 unless capacity and new scenario coverage exist; no untested code in live route.
description: Design v2 lane-change safety contract and HOLD edge-block reroute; estimate separately before implementation.
evidence: Wayfinder v2 decision and future backlog

title: Specify remote protocol, sessions and timestamp domains
acceptance: Contract rejects old/duplicate/out-of-order/session-mismatched responses; no cross-host timestamp subtraction.
description: Version request with run/session/frame IDs, capture/send timing, JPEG metadata; server returns boxes and duration.

title: Build inference server with isolated tracker sessions
acceptance: Two clients cannot share track state; reset and health endpoint tests pass using fake detector.
description: FastAPI service wraps same ObjectDetector; serialize per-session requests, bound queues and expire sessions.

title: Package offline Docker service and model assets
acceptance: Container starts with mounted local weights and documented resource limits; invalid JPEG/size rejected.
description: Pin dependency/model versions; no network downloads at first inference; endpoint/token from environment.

title: Implement nonblocking RemoteDetector and JPEG client
acceptance: Mock server tests cover timeout/malformed/stale/out-of-order results; core control thread never blocks on HTTP.
description: Bound in-flight requests and deadlines; preserve frame IDs and enforce response schema.

title: Implement concurrent local fallback and recovery policy
acceptance: Server failure chooses fresh local result within one tick; if both miss deadline, controlled stop; recovery hysteresis tested.
description: Keep local detector warm and independently runnable; remote preferred only if valid before deadline.

title: Test server-client sessions and tracker source switching
acceptance: Multi-client, repeated episode, failure/recovery and backend switch fixtures pass without lost safety state.
description: Use replay through local Docker; maintain source namespaces and prevent resuming on an ID change.

title: Build latency sweep and breakdown script
acceptance: p50/p95/max and deadline-miss rate by image size/JPEG quality; no fake separate upload/download timing.
description: Measure client end-to-end, encode/decode and server duration; RTT residual includes transfer/queue uncertainty.

title: Prepare optional cloud deployment and reproduce local server
acceptance: Local Docker works offline; cloud endpoint/provisioning status explicit; no claimed cloud speedup without measurement.
description: Document provider-neutral container deploy, HTTPS/token and budget cap; deploy only to supplied authorized account.

title: Compare local, LAN and available cloud inference
acceptance: Comparable latency/accuracy table and miss rates; upload/download one-way estimates labelled unless synchronized.
description: Use identical replay/model/hardware notes with warmup and >=200 frames/config; unavailable cloud marked NOT RUN.

title: Verify cloud outage, restart and session cleanup offline
acceptance: No old-session results applied; deadline misses do not advance clear-frame counter; local service logs preserved.
description: Kill server mid-sequence; repeat delayed response and rapid restart with new session.

title: Run CARLA cloud failover on demo-class hardware
acceptance: Fallback within one control tick when fresh local exists; otherwise stop; measure actual frame age and loop p95.
description: Ricky/Saviour supply service; Zhaolin runs CARLA and kills server; repeat resource-contention case.

title: Run full baseline regression with hybrid flag enabled
acceptance: 30 trials pass; include server-off interval; local GPU contention and deadline misses reported.
description: S0-S5 five trials each with offline local server/forced failures; online cloud remains optional.

title: Decide whether to add a remote Wayfinder endpoint
acceptance: Recorded defer/admit decision; server endpoint excluded from required offline demo.
description: Reuse plain graph and route output only if E3 is stable and evidence/report time remains.

title: Specify forward parking goal and signed motion hook
acceptance: MotionState carries signed speed only in new API; PARK defaults off; P1 target <=0.3 m and <=5 deg.
description: Define bay pose/clearance, final heading and DRIVE/PARK mode; preserve A1 nonnegative VehicleState.

title: Implement smooth forward bay approach in harness
acceptance: Synthetic bays satisfy turning radius, position and heading tolerances; invalid bays rejected.
description: Generate curvature-feasible arcs/Bezier with full vehicle footprint; final speed <=1 m/s.

title: Add parking clearance, final stop and state handover
acceptance: Blocked bay stops safely; DRIVE->PARK once; no endpoint completion before pose/heading constraints hold.
description: Use depth/LiDAR observed clearance; shorter lookahead/config for parking; validate orientation at goal.

title: Implement reverse two-arc parking prototype in harness
acceptance: Harness reverse path respects direction/sign and curvature; P2 remains experimental until CARLA evidence.
description: New signed-speed reverse controller and gear-safe command type; do not mutate forward-only A1 API.

title: Verify reverse gear hook and low-speed adapter signs
acceptance: Reverse sign, brake hold and gear-change interlock verified; P2 disabled in release configuration.
description: Add adapter reverse switching only after stopped; isolated calibration pad, not baseline mission.

title: Run five P1 forward parking trials and blocked-bay test
acceptance: 5/5 within 0.3 m and 5 deg, 0 collisions; time-to-park and blocked-bay safe stop captured.
description: Use selected destination bay with observed clearance; <=1 m/s final approach.

title: Run full baseline regression with parking flag enabled
acceptance: 30 baseline trials and P1 remain passing; default route goal unchanged when parking off.
description: Use DRIVE behavior on S0-S5; explicit P1 test covers PARK mode at permitted destination.

title: Evaluate P2 reverse parking or record the cut
acceptance: Admit only if 5/5 <=0.3 m, <=5 deg and 0 collisions plus regression; otherwise label future work.
description: Only spend this budget if P1 and baseline are green; otherwise record defer with harness evidence.
evidence: P2 measured result or cut record

title: Create report outline and evidence index
acceptance: Outline reserves <=1000 words and <=3 pages; no result inserted before measurement.
description: Map four mandatory report sections to tasks, figures, raw run IDs and decision records.

title: Draft scope and A1 reuse sections with cited changes
acceptance: Draft distinguishes approved baseline, pending extensions and simulator localization limitation; claims link to commits.
description: Explain reduced scope, retained controllers, revamped APIs and why map route is appropriate.

title: Update installation and offline reproduction scripts
acceptance: Fresh environment recipe has offline model manifest, matching server/client version and clear error messages.
description: Pin validated runtime/model assets and add prerequisites/checks for GPU/CARLA; update setup_environment.py.

title: Draft quantitative evidence and honest limitations
acceptance: No fabricated results; four sections have source run IDs and evidence-to-claim mapping.
description: Use all baseline trial counts; add range, depth, navigation and latency figures; failures remain visible.

title: Complete generated API documentation and module notes
acceptance: sphinx-build -W succeeds and links resolve; code explanation kept out of short report.
description: Add how/why notes for every module; show public protocol and data flow in Sphinx.

title: Run combined extension configuration regression
acceptance: S0-S5 five trials each pass, or identify which flag is disabled; selected config recorded for G4.
description: Run all admitted v1 flags together, not only in isolation; profile resource contention.

title: Freeze admitted extensions and the live demo configuration
acceptance: Each flag has pass/cut reason and evidence; baseline rerun after final change; no feature merge after freeze except fixes.
description: Use conditional tasks only as evidence; cut failed flags without weakening baseline thresholds.

title: Produce final metrics table and report figures
acceptance: Figures legible at report size, correct units/denominators, captions explain conditions and all claims reproducible.
description: Create compact architecture, before/after CTE and stop timeline plus selective extension result table.

title: Write design choices and limitations for selected release
acceptance: Text states actual final flags, simulator pose/topology allowance, green lights and stationary-obstacle limit.
description: Compare map path versus noisy per-frame route, depth versus pinhole, local versus cloud and cut features.

title: Verify core fresh clone as a non-author of application modules
acceptance: Clean-clone log records commands/versions and fixes; no hidden local files needed.
description: Clone new directory, fetch LFS, install, run lint/tests/docs and harness; use only README instructions.

title: Reproduce complete demo from a fresh clone on backup machine
acceptance: Entire mission and required sensors work from fresh checkout; capture hardware differences and final hash.
description: Alan follows docs for adapter/planner modules primarily authored by others; use local weights and network-off mode.

title: Write an eight-minute demo script with named speakers
acceptance: Timed run-of-show fits 8 min; commands and recovery-to-video steps copied into demo checklist.
description: Allocate six speaking roles, live S1/S2 proof, evidence screens and extension segment; reserve Q&A two minutes.

title: Record backup demonstration and evidence screenshots
acceptance: Video plays offline on both laptops with audio/captions as needed; file ready for Canvas submission.
description: Capture complete baseline and admitted extension snippets on final release hash; include readable metrics.

title: Assemble report PDF and check both length limits
acceptance: All required sections, citations and limitations present; figures/captions excluded from word count; PDF visually checked.
description: Target 900-950 words across four sections; verify <=1000 words and <=3 pages conservatively.
evidence: Final draft PDF and count log

title: Review report claims against raw runs and source code
acceptance: Every numeric claim traces to data; incorrect/unsupported claims fixed before final handoff.
description: A reviewer checks metric definitions, comparison fairness, extension statuses and controller explanation.

title: Lead rehearsal one on the demo laptop
acceptance: Time, failures and every member's knowledge gaps recorded; offline backup launch practiced.
description: Run full 8-minute show and 2-minute random Q&A with all six present.

title: Lead rehearsal two and cross-module Q&A
acceptance: All six explain any module; two timed rehearsals complete; final defects resolved or release flag cut.
description: Use final script and random member selection; verify backup laptop and power/display setup.

title: Check submission readiness and prepare final release
acceptance: All artifacts ready; official Canvas submissions marked pending until each member confirms; no false submission claim.
description: Verify report, repo URL, final tag, backup video, docs and known real deadlines; distribute checklist privately.

title: Verify sensor timeout and stale-snapshot stopping
acceptance: Fault sends brake within next available tick; no mixed-frame obstacles; restart requires explicit reset policy.
description: Inject missing RGB/depth and mismatched ego timestamps; restore sensors after fault.

title: Check geometry and stopping metric golden fixtures
acceptance: Metric output distinguishes Euclidean distance, route gap and stopping surface distance; empty results stay missing.
description: Construct known bumper offsets, signed corridor poses and expected longitudinal gaps.

title: Stress HOLD under occlusion and missing observations
acceptance: Vehicle remains stopped for 60 s despite track expiry; resumes only on validated clear observations.
description: Keep physical obstacle present while masking detector outputs, missing depth and switching IDs.

title: Stress controller exceptions and endpoint overshoot handling
acceptance: No seven-second command reuse; emergency stop is latched/logged; restart/goal behavior documented.
description: Inject invalid state, behind-target error and loss of path; use isolated scenario at low speed.

title: Profile the full sensor rig and reduce unnecessary cadence
acceptance: Real-time factor and p95 E2E reported; optional workloads rate-limited without misusing stale masks.
